channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Obama slams Trump’s ‘cruelty and corruption’ at Ohio rally for Democrats
item.description: Former US president says Trump 'chose to make a series of bad decisions', highlighting the US-Israel war on Iran.

item.title: Iran war live: Trump hints at possible Sunday Iran attack or deal reached
item.description: Trump says US is considering a possible attack on Iran as soon as Sunday, or it could reach a major deal with Tehran.

item.title: Iran blames US for deal failure, urges new try amid fear of new attacks
item.description: Tehran warns that even limited strikes would trigger a response 'several times greater'.

item.title: Houthis launch attacks on Saudi Arabia and Yemen’s Aden
item.description: Houthi missiles reportedly struck a number of targets in Yemen, including Aden's airport and a coastguard base.

item.title: Thousands gather at new Albanian antigovernment rally
item.description: More than 300 protesters and police were injured in the Albanian capital Tirana's fiercest clashes in days.

item.title: Palestinian families displaced as Israeli forces demolish Hebron homes
item.description: The crackdown follows the killing of two Israeli soldiers by two Palestinian gunmen on Friday - and comes just days ahead of Israel's election.

item.title: Father who killed Oregon school gunman describes anguish over children he couldn't save
item.description: Kaylub Giamanco has been hailed as a hero for killing a teenager who fatally shot three children and a teacher.

item.title: Deadly shooting near Paris is a 'racist terrorist attack', Macron says
item.description: One person is killed and five wounded in a series of attacks. The suspected gunman has been apprehended.
